title: Define and enforce body-loss authority across all stream discontinuities
outcome: Architect1 decides loss scope and recovery contract for ordinary EventSource reconnect, shared-worker rejoin, fallback adoption and instance restart; inherited uncovered-body behavior is not silently treated as repaired.
acceptance: For every in-scope discontinuity, a runtime regression loses a resident update then admits a disjoint tail and proves no stale body is certified while selected navigation remains valid.
The coordinator and architect record which stream discontinuities invalidate resident-body authority and why.
